ns2:section.sectionText: By utilizing a competitive simulation, students will be introduced to the business functions of finance, marketing, operations, and their strategic integration for business success. In addition, a focus on important professional skills will enhance the students’ capacity as professionals. The course will consist of a team simulation, on-line content, and class discussions. Finally, the course is designed to engage and build students to become the next business leaders.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Gies College of Business. Restricted to students with Sophomore class standing.
